after: Manual requests for the same task are unaffected, because escalation puts a human in the loop rather than closing the task. The refusal names the scope key that tripped and the completion that clears it. (Amended APRV-280.) On a harness surface the floor routes the side-effecting classes of a tool call and no others, so this code does not fire for a call whose classes are all `read.*` (§10.2). (Amended APRV-297, pending sign-off.) |
